def: a log (as cut out); also well or cistern (as dug)

occurrences.text: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
And he said, Thus saith the Lord, Make this valley full of ditches.

And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
